quarterly_data.quarter: Pasqal press release: Pasqal Reaffirms its Commitment to the EU's Quantum (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal coordinates Q-PLANET (Quantum Pilot Line for production of Advanced chips for Neutral atom European Technologies), co-funded by the EU Chips Joint Undertaking and national / regional authorities with €50 million over three years: 28 partners from 11 European countries will develop industrial-grade chip components for neutral-atom computing, sensing and communication - lasers at 461 nm, 698 nm, 795 nm and 1013 nm, atom chips and microfabricated vapor cells - plus standardized process and assembly design kits. Pasqal leads development of the chip-based 1013nm laser sources and is an end-user of the vapor cells and laser sources; the pilot line kicked off in Brussels three months before the release.
quarterly_data.figure: €50 million over three years; 28 partners from 11 countries
